Akar Pure / Brand Story
Our Story

From Greece, with care.
A simple promise in every bottle.

Akar Pure is built around fruit, origin and clarity — presenting organic pomegranate juice in a way that feels honest, refined and easy to understand.

The beginning

Real fruit. Thoughtful choices.

The brand story centres on pomegranate and a clean-label approach: no added sugar, no colouring, no flavouring and no preservatives. It is a product philosophy designed to feel uncomplicated — from what goes into the bottle to how the brand communicates with customers.

AKAR PUREZero compromise · Product of Greece

Four ideas behind the brand.

01

Fruit First

Pomegranate remains the hero — visually, in flavour and in the product story.

02

Clear Choices

Simple claims and straightforward product information help customers understand what they are choosing.

03

Greek Origin

The origin story gives Akar Pure a distinctive identity and a strong sense of place.

04

Everyday Wellness

Designed to fit naturally into a modern daily routine without overcomplicating the experience.
